d: Short, charcoal grey hair with blunt bangs and two low pigtails frames a youthful, child-like face with large, dark brown, wide-eyed eyes. The build is small and slender, dressed in a white sleeveless tank top with a red circular emblem on the chest, worn over white bottoms, and accessorized with an orange strap harness and a red belt of floatation beads around the waist. A grey diving mask is perched on the forehead, and a small grey metal kettle is held by a thin string in one hand.
